dI0 - netramityAdi | netraM yantraM bastigatasnehakaShAyAdidravyaM nayanaM cArutvAnnetramiti saMj~jA | kimarthaM bastividhAnArthaM bastidArDhyArthaM | tacca suvarNAdidhAtuBirvidhIyate kriyate | AdigrahaNAdraupyatAmratrapulohAdInAM grahaNam | tathA veNvAdiBirveNurvaMSaH | nalairnalikAdiBiH tRuNaviSeShajAtaiH | dantairhastidantaiH | viShANAgrairiti SRu~ggAgraiH | uparitanasUkShmaBAgaiH| maNiBirmarakatapuShparAgavaiDUryAdiBiH | etena SuddhapAShANairapi vidhIyata iti sampradAyaH | uktaM ca dRuDhabalena - ‘suvarNarUpyatraputAmrarItikAMsyAya#foot@ - ‘sthi Sastra’ iti carake pAThaH |#sAsPigdrumaveNudantaiH | nalairviShANairmaNiBiSca taistaiH kAryANi netrANi trikarNikAni | ShaDdvAdaSAShTA~ggulasaMmitAni ShaDMviSatidvAdaSavarShajAnAm | syurmudgakarkandhusatInavAhi CidrANi vartyA pihitAni cApi | yathAvayo~a~gguShThakaniShThikAByAM mUlAgrayoH syu: pariNAhavanti | RujUni gopucCasamAkRutIni SlakShNAni vA syurguTikAmuKAni | syAtkarNikaikAgracaturthaBAge mUlASrite bandhanibandhane dve | jaradgavo mAhiShahAriNo vA syAcCaukaro bastirajasya vA~api’ iti ( ca. saM. 3) | sPigasthi | atha netraparimANamAha - ekavarShAditi | ekavarShAtprathamavarShAtShaDvarShaM yAvat tAvanmAnaM netrasya ShaDa~ggulaM yAvanmAnaM ShaDvarSham, etatparimANamAyAmena kathitaM | ShaDvarShAdUrdhvaM yAvat dvAdaSavarShANi tAvannetrAyAmaparimANaM daSA~ggulam | eke - ‘mAnaM syAdaShTasaMmitam’ iti paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca | tataH paramiti dvAdaSavarShAdAraBya yAvadviMSativarShANi tAvaddvAdaSA~ggulaM netrAyAmam, ataH paraM netrAyAmatA nAstItyuktatvAt | vAgBaTe tu - ‘Une~abde pa~jcapUrNe~asminnA saptaByo~a~ggulAni ShaT | saptame sapta tAnyaShTau dvAdaSe ShoDaSe nava | dvAdaSaiva paraM viSAdvIkShya varShAntareShu ca | vayo balaSarIrANi pramANamaBivardhayet’ iti | atha netrAgrarandhraparimANamAha - mudgetyAdi | ShaDa~ggulanetrasya mudgapramANaM AkAreNa vartulatvAt | tacca svinnam, evaM mAShAdirapi Kinnameva | uktaM ca vAgBaTe - ‘mudga mAShaM kalAyAnnaM svinnaM karkandhukaM kramAt’ iti | kaShAyo~atra vartulakalAyaH satInasaMj~ja | yathAsaMKyamiti krameNa ityarthaH | tacca netraM SlakShNaM komalaM | gopucCAkAramiti | AkAreNa AturA~gguShThamAnena mUlasthUlam | mUlamatra carmabandhanamuKam | 
agre ca netrAgre kaniShThikApariNAhatA j~jeyA | agre iti gudAsannihitamuKe | guTikAmuKamiti | tadagramuKe ca guTikA kAryA vartulA ityarthaM: | tanmUle iti | netrasya mUle carmalagnamuKe dve karNike kArye | karNikA meKalASabdavAcyA yayoScarmapuTakAgraM saMnahyate | ata evAha - ‘yojayettatra bastiM ca bandhadvayavidhAnata’ iti | dvAByAM bandhanAByAM netre bastiM badhva#093E; gudAdau yojayetpraveSayedityarthaH | caturthaBAgAdityAdi | etena uttaramuKe caturthaBAgaparyantam ekA karNikA kAryA iti vaidyasampradAyaH | tatastAM maryAdIkRutya gudamadhye praveSayedityarthaH | uktaMca cakradatte - ‘syAtkarNe cAgracaturthaBAge mUlASrite bastinibandhane dve’ ityAdi | bastinetrakaraNadravyaprasaMgAdvraNabastimAha - tu punaH vraNabasteH, vraNo nADIvraNaH tannimittaM yannetraM yantraM SlakShNaM komalaM tathA~aShTA~ggulonmitaM parimANaM netraM kAryam | etacca pUrvoktabastidravyasya mudgacCidraM nalikAyantraM sacCidraM bahIrandhraM kAryam | tathA gRudhrapakShanalikApariNAhi, tena nalikApariNAhamAnamuktam || 7-14 ||
